notes: Mappings follow the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API clauses. The test first sets and reads a valid standard directive while joined, restores NO_ACTION before resignation, then verifies FederateNotExecutionMember after resignation while connected and NotConnected after disconnect. InvalidResignAction is not exercised because only valid ResignAction values are supplied.

requirements.statement: The API declares FederateNotExecutionMember and NotConnected for this getter. The test verifies it is callable while joined, then expects the corresponding exception after resignation and disconnect.
The API declares FederateNotExecutionMember and NotConnected for this setter. The test uses valid ResignAction values only and expects the corresponding exception after resignation and disconnect.
